name: The Great Windborne Cat Spirit

angles.text: As a druid, you must show cunning and ferocity before the spirit grants its shapeshifting blessing. The rite teaches you to channel the wild cat's agility, stealth, and predatory instinct.

As a night elf, you can trace the Stormrage Barrow Den's name to one of the most prominent night elven druidic lineages. Its depths connect Kaldorei practitioners to their people's ancient barrow heritage and ancestral spirits.

faq.answer: The Great Windborne Cat Spirit guides young druids in mastering feline shapeshifting. Through the Avatar of Saeyleenan, it embodies cunning, stealth, and ferocity. It tests aspirants before granting its form, to ensure they respect the cat's instincts and nature.
faq.q: Who is the Great Windborne Cat Spirit?

faq.answer: The Avatar of Saeyleenan speaks for the Great Windborne Cat Spirit and stands west of the Stormrage Barrow Den. It assigns seekers to recover the stolen or hidden relics, then evaluates whether each initiate has shown enough stealth and cunning to earn the feline blessing.
faq.q: What is the Avatar of Saeyleenan?

faq.answer: The trial calls for the Relic of the Fang, the Relic of the Claw, and the Relic of the Silent Shadow, all found in the Stormrage Barrow Den. Together, they symbolize the cat's physical weapons and elusive stealth, and prove an initiate's reverence for every aspect of the predator.
faq.q: What relics are required for the trial?

faq.answer: The Stormrage Barrow Den lies just east of the Avatar of Saeyleenan. Its subterranean chambers hold the three sacred relics and test the druids. Initiates must avoid the enraged spirits wandering its dark tunnels.
faq.q: Where is the Stormrage Barrow Den located?

faq.answer: The Stormrage Barrow Den is overrun by powerful enraged spirits that attack living intruders on sight. They are hostile threats, not willing guardians. Their presence forces aspiring druids to use cunning and stealth to recover the relics instead of fighting them directly.
faq.q: Why are enraged spirits guarding the barrow den?

faq.answer: A stone statue at the Stormrage Barrow Den's entrance grants seekers a temporary blessing of stealth. Young initiates have not yet earned their own cat form or prowling abilities, so the enchantment helps them pass the hostile spirits unseen and secure the relics.
faq.q: How do seekers sneak past the enraged spirits?

aliases: what do you get from cat spirit
faq.answer: When the seeker returns the Relic of the Fang, the Relic of the Claw, and the Relic of the Silent Shadow, the Avatar of Saeyleenan deems them worthy of the Great Windborne Cat Spirit's blessing. The rite shows their understanding of the cat's nature and grants the spiritual approval needed to take the predator's shape.
faq.q: What reward or blessing is granted upon completing the trial?

sections.body: A seeker must show the nature of a predator before drawing upon the Great Windborne Cat Spirit. The cat calls for cunning and patience, then fierce action when cornered. The spirit tests those who seek its power, asking them to think, move, and strike like wild feline hunters. Only then may an initiate earn the right to take the cat's shape.
sections.title: The Trial of Cunning and Stealth

sections.body:
The trial leads into the Stormrage Barrow Den, just east of the spirit's avatar. Three sacred tokens lie in its halls: the Relic of the Fang, the Relic of the Claw, and the Relic of the Silent Shadow.

Enraged spirits have overrun the den and attack intruders on sight. A seeker cannot rely on brute force alone, but must tread carefully through the darkness to reach the relics.
sections.title: The Stormrage Barrow Den

sections.body:
The Avatar of Saeyleenan is the physical manifestation through which the Great Windborne Cat Spirit speaks to young initiates. Untutored seekers lack a seasoned predator's stealth, so a statue at the barrow den's entrance grants them temporary concealment.

Those who slip past the frenzied spirits and return all three relics show they have learned the predator's ways. The Avatar recognizes their worthiness and grants the blessing to wield cat form.
sections.title: The Avatar of Saeyleenan

summary: At the Avatar of Saeyleenan, young druids face a trial of cunning and stealth. They enter the nearby Stormrage Barrow Den to recover three relics while avoiding enraged spirits. Passing the rite earns them the blessing to wield cat form.
